description: 测量单个进程计算 32 MiB SHA-256 的耗时

stages.name: 计算摘要
command:
import hashlib, json, os, time
from pathlib import Path

data = bytes(1024 * 1024)
digest = hashlib.sha256()
start = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(32):
    digest.update(data)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
output = Path(os.environ['GHS_OUTPUT_DIR']) / 'sha256.txt'
output.write_text(digest.hexdigest() + '\n')
observation = dict(version=1, metric='elapsed', value=elapsed, unit='s', direction='min',
                   location='sha256.update loop', protocol='sha256-32MiB-v1', source='artifacts/sha256.txt')
Path(os.environ['GHS_RESULTS']).write_text(json.dumps(observation) + '\n')
print(f'Hashed 32 MiB in {elapsed:.6f} s')
